title: jasminum pubescens
intro: Jasminum pubescens, commonly known as the Himalayan jasmine or Bengal jasmine, is a flowering plant species in the jasmine family. This plant has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress, improve sleep, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Jasminum pubescens include its ability to act as a sedative, anxiolytic, and anti-anxiety agent, which may help to alleviate symptoms of anxiety, insomnia, and restlessness. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
